notes.title: Farewell from Team 1 & Last Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This will be our final update for Palette Cleanser. As of today, we are officially ending development and support for the game. The team is disbanding, and we’re all moving on to new adventures, some of us to other projects, others finishing up our studies, and a few just catching up on sleep.

We want to thank every single one of you who played, shared feedback, or simply spent time in our little garden world. This game started as a student project, but your support made it feel like something much more.

To wrap things up properly, we’ve released one last patch that fixes a handful of lingering bugs and adds some final polish. You can find the full patch notes below.

Thanks again for being part of this journey.
– Team 1 

Patch notes:

Fixed delayed music after returning to main menu

Fixed ramp animation and lighting

Fixed bug with ranged enemies assigned to sprinklers

Fixed airdash spam when jumping on the ramp

Applied emissive materials to fans

Fixed collision on breakable walls

Fixed quitting issue when opening settings from the pause menu

Fixed issue where pressing jump after pausing reopened the pause menu

Fixed settings menu requiring multiple clicks when accessed from pause

Fixed credits scene speed

New 

Sprinkler animations

More desaturated objects

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes:
That’s right, the brushes are down, the paint’s dry, and Palette Cleanser is officially released!

After months of development, testing, and your incredible feedback during the demo and Next Fest, we’re thrilled to finally open the doors to the full experience!



What’s new in the full release?

Onboarding tutorials

Updated mechanics and smoother gameplay

Bug fixes, polish passes, and performance boosts

More color,  more animations, more fun

Achievements!



Thank you all for your support. This project couldn’t have come to life without your enthusiasm, feedback, and chaos.

— Team 1

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
What’s New

Corruption: Now you can clean the corruption off the environment as you slide. 

The garden is bigger: More plants, obstacles, sections and ninja paths!



Fixes & Improvements

The world is even more desaturated to clearly differentiate between the corrupted sections and the cleaned ones.

Camera is now easily controllable. 

Various collision issue are now patched

Placeholder assets have been replaced

Updated breakable walls

Big Main menu and Pause menu bugs have been addressed



We Want Your Feedback

Jump into our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/HKGSBJqN

Report issues with out build-in tool through the Pause menu

Follow us on Social Media: https://x.com/Pa1etteC1eanser & Palette Cleanser (@palettecleanser) | TikTok



Thank You!

Big thanks to everyone who’s played so far! Your feedback shapes the game.  

Stay tuned for more updates!



With love, 
Team 1
